# Skill catalog

<!-- generated by `python -m omi skills`; do not edit -->
- write-skill (authoring): Use when creating or revising an omi-skill; gives the contract, trigger wording and acceptance test. [~713 tokens]
- brainstorm-ac (workflow): Use when a requirement or feature request is vague and must become testable acceptance criteria before a task file is written. [~618 tokens]
- change-request (workflow): Use when requirements, scope or an approved decision change after a task started, or an engineer reports NEEDS SCOPE. [~520 tokens]
- lean-implementation (workflow): Use when writing or fixing code and tempted to add abstractions, dependencies or config; keeps the diff minimal (YAGNI, stdlib first). [~571 tokens]
- task-brief (workflow): Use when a task file must be complete enough for a fresh engineer agent with zero context, before `omi run`. [~580 tokens]
